acceptance: 1) Entry: First authenticator setup (login-enroll) on /admin-login -> /admin-enroll. Data sources: POST /api/auth-admin/enroll and POST /api/auth-admin/enroll/confirm. A real existing-token/email/password form yields the URI, then confirmation with the next unused new code yields one-time recovery-code display. Before confirmation the passwordless toggle stays false; wrong/expired/replayed enrollment changes nothing (E-05, E-08). 2) Keep token/URI/codes only in memory. Immediately clear a historical fragment after import and clear secrets on pagehide. Do not reuse the confirmed code for sign-in; return to login and actually sign in with a new code in the next step. Email alone without a valid token cannot enroll (E-10). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.

E-05.scene: C-03 Authenticator enrollment and the passwordless-default toggle
E-05.trigger: The account has not yet enrolled an authenticator.
E-05.expect: Continue through an existing usable sign-in method into enrollment. Enable passwordless-default sign-in only after the new authenticator has been correctly verified; do not enable it for all accounts in bulk.

E-08.scene: C-03 Authenticator enrollment and the passwordless-default toggle
E-08.trigger: An enrollment code is wrong or expired, a submission is repeated, or switches occur concurrently.
E-08.expect: Test all four triggers separately. In the final transaction, recheck the pending enrollment record, validity period, and current credential version. Do not commit wrong, expired, or replayed submissions; at most one of two concurrent switches succeeds. After a failure, querying the account must still show at least one verified sign-in method. Follow section 09 without inventing another sign-in method.

E-10.scene: C-04 Lost authenticator and single-administrator recovery
E-10.expect: Do not show a recovery code as required. A separate Cannot use your authenticator entry opens recovery. Supplying only an account identifier or email address cannot grant reset authority.
